about.title: Where Melodies Meet Passion
paragraphs: Music Club VITCC, one of the oldest and most prestigious cultural clubs at VIT Chennai, brings forward the culmination of some of the most talented musicians from around the country.
The excellent musical taste, arduous effort, and dedication of all members inspire the club to organize numerous events, stage productions, and college concerts throughout the year.
Make sure to catch us live at various events across the campus, whether it be the soulful sargams of classical ragas or the heavy headbangs of hardcore rock.

faqs.q: When are auditions held for freshers?
faqs.a: Club auditions are conducted every academic year right after the Fresher's Talent Hunt. Circulars and audition dates are posted on our Instagram @vitcmusicclub.

faqs.q: Can non-members book the music room?
faqs.a: The music room is reserved for verified club members and registered bands. During Open Mic weeks, slots may open to other students with prior registration.

faqs.q: How do I register a new band?
faqs.a: Sign in to the Member Portal, navigate to 'My Bands', and submit the registration form with between 3 and 9 members.

faqs.q: What instruments does the club provide?
faqs.a: The club maintains Fender Stratocaster electric guitars, Yamaha acoustic guitars, Ibanez 5-string bass, Roland XPS-30 synthesizers, Pearl drumkits, and Shure vocal microphones.

instructions.title: Instructions & Rules
instructions.subtitle: Standard operating rules for verified musicians regarding registration, music room slots, and equipment custody.

tabs.label: 1. Account Setup
tabs.title: Member Registration & Verification
tabs.subtitle: Official authentication and profile activation steps for club musicians
tabs.notice: Club auditions are conducted every academic year right after the Freshers' Talent Hunt. Verified members receive notifications for all internal jam sessions.

items.title: Access the Member Portal
items.desc: Click on 'Member Login' in the navigation bar to sign in or initiate registration for club membership.

items.title: VIT Student Email Required
items.desc: Sign up using your official institutional email (e.g. name2024@vitstudent.ac.in). External domains are restricted.

items.title: Registration Number Validation
items.desc: Enter your 9-character VIT registration number (e.g. 24BCE5259) and declare your primary instruments or vocal roles.

items.title: Spam & Inbox Verification
items.desc: Check your Outlook inbox for the confirmation email. If not visible immediately, check the Junk/Spam folder.

items.title: Full Member Privileges Unlocked
items.desc: Once verified, you have complete access to book soundproof slots, register official bands, and request gear.

tabs.label: 2. Music Room Booking
tabs.title: Music Room & Slot Reservation
tabs.subtitle: Advance reservation rules, duration limits, and studio scheduling policies
tabs.notice: Slot hoarding across multiple accounts of the same band is monitored by club admins and may result in temporary booking suspensions.

items.title: Advance Booking Window
items.desc: Practice slots open up to 7 days ahead. Reservations must be requested at least 12 hours prior to practice.

items.title: Slot Duration Limits
items.desc: Standard rehearsal sessions are 55 to 110 minutes per band per day. Extended sessions for fests require board approval.

items.title: Cancellation Courtesy
items.desc: Cancel at least 4 hours ahead if your group is unable to attend to free up the room for fellow club musicians.

items.title: Equipment Power Shutdown
items.desc: Always switch off guitar amplifier heads, Roland synthesizers, and PA mixers immediately after your session.

items.title: Studio Cleanliness Standard
items.desc: Coil audio cables, return mic stands to the corner, and ensure no bottles or trash are left in the sound room.

tabs.label: 3. Instrument Policy
tabs.title: Instrument Requisition Policy
tabs.subtitle: Borrowing electric guitars, synthesizers, drum hardware, and stage audio gear
tabs.notice: Guitar picks, spare patch cords, drum keys, and vocal mic sanitizing wipes are available in the equipment cabinet upon request.

items.title: Verified Member Eligibility
items.desc: Only registered club members in good standing may borrow club guitars, synthesizers, and stage hardware.

items.title: Same-Day Return Schedule
items.desc: Equipment borrowed for on-campus rehearsals must be returned to the music room inventory by 9:00 PM on the same day.

items.title: External Fest Clearance
items.desc: Taking club instruments off campus for intercollegiate fests requires written approval from the Faculty Coordinator.

items.title: Borrower Accountability
items.desc: Physical damage, dropped microphones, or missing power adapters will be billed to the borrower's registration number.

items.title: Pre-Issue Cable Inspection
items.desc: Test all guitar jacks, XLR cables, and power adapters with a club board member before signing out any equipment.

tabs.label: 4. Band Guidelines
tabs.title: Official Band Formation Guidelines
tabs.subtitle: Roster composition limits, band leadership, and collegiate competition rules
tabs.notice: Looking for musicians to complete your lineup? Drop a message in the official club WhatsApp group to connect with vocalists and instrumentalists.

items.title: Lineup Size Requirements
items.desc: An official club band must consist of at least 3 active student musicians and cannot exceed 9 members.

items.title: Designated Band Leader
items.desc: Every band must designate a leader responsible for slot bookings, equipment custody, and fest coordination.

items.title: Dual-Roster Participation
items.desc: Musicians may participate in up to two official club bands, provided rehearsal schedules and fest competitions do not conflict.

items.title: Credential Authentication
items.desc: Every member in your lineup must confirm their inclusion using their registration number and secret key credential.

items.title: Collegiate Fest Representation
items.desc: Only approved, verified bands may officially compete under the VIT Chennai Music Club banner at national fests.

tabs.label: 5. Studio Etiquette
tabs.title: Studio Etiquette & Noise Regulations
tabs.subtitle: Sound isolation protocols, equipment safety, and campus curfew compliance
tabs.notice: Failure to adhere to studio etiquette, hostel curfew, or equipment safety guidelines will result in temporary suspension of music room booking rights.

items.title: Soundproof Double Doors
items.desc: Both acoustic doors of the music room must remain securely latched during all amplified guitar, synth, and drum sessions.

items.title: Strict Beverage & Liquid Ban
items.desc: Open drinks, water bottles, and tea/coffee cups are strictly prohibited on or near amplifiers, pedalboards, and synthesizers.

items.title: Hostel In-Time Curfew
items.desc: Evening rehearsals conclude promptly by 8:30 PM on weekdays in adherence to VIT Chennai hostel curfew guidelines.

items.title: Acoustic Volume Calibration
items.desc: Keep master stage amplifiers and drum monitors below 85 dB to prevent sound spill into adjacent academic blocks.

items.title: Punctuality & Transition
items.desc: Arrive on time, wrap up playing 5 minutes before your slot ends, and leave the rehearsal room clean for the incoming band.
